The application is based on the scientific research. It helps to determine the fertile days of the month, so you can either achieve or avoid pregnancy. The popular baby gender prediction method is used by default. But it’s based only on the widely-spread theory by Landrum Shettles. - Chances of conceiving a girl or a boy during the current period.
